create_proxy_state: create a ProxyState instance to manage proxy server state variables like spend_logs_row_count
get_proxy_state_variable: get the value of a proxy state variable such as spend_logs_row_count from a ProxyState instance
set_proxy_state_variable: set a proxy state variable value like spend_logs_row_count on a ProxyState instance
test_ProxyState: test the ProxyState class get and set proxy state variable methods
review_ProxyState: review the ProxyState class and its get and set proxy state variable methods
